IP: 15.252.137.16 | Device: Desktop The week wise Structure of the Internship is as Follows:

Week 1 Deep Learning & PyTorch Foundations Introduction to deep learning, PyTorch tensors and autograd, building and training neural networks using nn module, loss functions, optimizers, and training loops. Week 2 Transformers & Hugging Face Ecosystem Attention mechanisms, transformer architecture, working with Hugging Face models, tokenization, and running inference with pre-trained LLMs. Week 3 Fine-Tuning & PEFT Techniques Preparing custom datasets, fine-tuning pre-trained models using Trainer API, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA and QLoRA. Week 4 Embeddings & Vector Databases Text embeddings, semantic similarity, cosine similarity, and vector search using FAISS, Chroma, and Pinecone for indexing and querying. Week 5 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Document processing, vector stores, RAG pipelines, prompting strategies, generation workflows, and evaluation techniques. Week 6 LLM Chatbots & AI Agents Building custom chatbots with memory and dialogue management, advanced LLM techniques including ReAct agents and tool integration. Week 7 Advanced Prompting, Evaluation & AI Ethics Prompt engineering, chain-of-thought & few-shot prompting, generative content creation, evaluation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, human eval), safety, bias detection, hallucination mitigation, and introduction to multi-modal generative AI. Serving, Monitoring Week 8 Best Practices for Deploying Generative AI Models & Capstone Project
